meta.name: init-first-agent
meta.description: Walk the operator through wiring the first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel — resolve the operator's channel identity, select or create the agent, and trigger a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Use after channel credentials are configured and the service is running.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把首个智能体接入私信频道并发出欢迎消息
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你刚布置好智能体服务,想快速接通私信频道。
copy.tagline_en: Connect your first agent to a DM channel and send a welcome message
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you've just set up an agent service and want to quickly wire it to a DM channel.

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会引导你把第一个 NanoClaw agent 接到某个 DM 渠道:解析你的渠道身份、创建或复用 agent 与 DM 消息组,并让 agent 走正常投递路径给你发一条欢迎私信,最后确认你是否收到。每一步都是幂等的,重复运行安全。
howto.when: 原文写明:在渠道凭据已配置、服务正在运行之后使用;还要求目标渠道已安装、适配器已连接,通常发生于你跑过 /setup 和 /add-<channel> 等之后。

say.text: 帮我把第一个 agent 接到 Discord 的私信上
say.note: 会依次问你渠道、你的用户 id、显示名和 agent 名

say.text: 用 Telegram 的配对码方式接入第一个 agent
say.note: 生成配对码,你在 Telegram 里发出即可完成配对

say.text: 欢迎私信没收到,帮我查一下 outbound 队列
say.note: 直接查会话数据库与日志定位卡住的消息

howto.what_en: Claude walks you through wiring your first NanoClaw agent to a DM channel: it resolves your channel identity, creates or reuses the agent and DM group, and triggers a welcome DM via the normal delivery path. Reruns are safe.
howto.when_en: Use it after channel credentials are configured, the service is running, the target channel is installed, and its adapter is connected — typically after /setup and an /add-<channel> run.

say_en.text: Set up the first agent for my Discord DMs
say_en.note: It asks for your channel, user id, display name, agent name.

say_en.text: Pair my first agent over Telegram with a pair code
say_en.note: It issues a code; send it in Telegram to finish pairing.

say_en.text: The welcome DM never arrived — check the queue
say_en.note: It queries the session DB and logs directly.
